decisions.proposed_text: Khi Số fan tăng (tối đa 200.000),\nTraining Effectiveness
decisions.reason: Current text preserves the condition but uses the forbidden Vietnamese calque for the canonical Support Effect label.
decisions.terminology_basis: progress.fans => Số fan; support.training_effectiveness.effect155 => Training Effectiveness.

decisions.proposed_text: Khi giá trị liên kết đạt từ 80 trở lên,\nStamina Bonus
decisions.reason: The Support Effect is a named player-facing label; the current 'Thưởng Thể lực' violates both Stamina and Stamina Bonus canonical terminology.

decisions.proposed_text: Khi đưa vào đội hình từ 4 loại Support Card trở lên, Training Effectiveness
decisions.reason: Both player-facing terms are currently literal Vietnamese calques and are explicitly forbidden by embedded canonical context.
decisions.terminology_basis: common.support_card/system.support_card => Support Card; support.training_effectiveness.effect155 => Training Effectiveness.

decisions.proposed_text: Khi giá trị liên kết đạt từ 100 trở lên,\nMood Effect
decisions.reason: The current wording translates the named Mood Effect label generically instead of using the required established terminology.

decisions.proposed_text: Dựa theo loại Support Card trong đội hình,\nThưởng chỉ số cơ bản ban đầu
decisions.reason: The sentence meaning is otherwise serviceable, but 'thẻ hỗ trợ' is a forbidden calque of the canonical player-facing Support Card term.

decisions.proposed_text: Khi thực hiện Friendship Training với thẻ này,\nFriendship Bonus tăng (tối đa 5 lần)
decisions.reason: The current line literal-translates both established player-facing Friendship Training and Friendship Bonus labels.
decisions.terminology_basis: common.friendship_training => Friendship Training; support.friendship_bonus.effect155 => Friendship Bonus.

decisions.proposed_text: Khi giá trị liên kết đạt từ 80 trở lên,\nSpeed Bonus
decisions.reason: The current Support Effect label is a forbidden Vietnamese calque of Speed Bonus.

decisions.proposed_text: Khi giá trị liên kết đạt từ 80 trở lên,\nPower Bonus
decisions.reason: The current Support Effect label is a forbidden Vietnamese calque of Power Bonus.

decisions.proposed_text: Thể lực hiện tại càng thấp,\nFriendship Bonus tăng càng nhiều
decisions.reason: The energy condition is fine, but the named Friendship Bonus Support Effect must use its established player-facing label.

decisions.proposed_text: Thể lực tối đa càng cao,\nTraining Effectiveness càng tăng
decisions.reason: The current text uses a forbidden Vietnamese calque for the canonical Training Effectiveness Support Effect.
Power Bonus is explicitly canonical; preserve the locked generic race terminology for the second conjunct rather than inventing an unembedded label.

decisions.proposed_text: Khi giá trị liên kết đạt từ 80 trở lên,\nWit Bonus&Thưởng Skill Pt
decisions.reason: The current line violates canonical Wit and Skill Pt terminology; no broader unembedded Support Effect name is invented.

decisions.proposed_text: Tăng hiệu quả sự kiện giảm giá&Thưởng Skill Pt
decisions.reason: The event-effect wording is retained, while the forbidden Vietnamese rendering of the player-facing Skill Pt resource is corrected.

decisions.proposed_text: Tổng giá trị liên kết của các Support Card trong đội hình càng cao,\nTraining Effectiveness càng tăng
decisions.reason: The current translation literal-translates both Support Card and Training Effectiveness despite explicit canonical requirements.
decisions.terminology_basis: common.support_card/system.support_card => Support Card; support.training_effectiveness.effect155 => Training Effectiveness.
